notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[list]
    [*] Added invert Y and camera offset in settings menu.
    [*] Changed the models of the tiles in the lava map and added visual cues to show what tiles break first.
    [*] Spell number tweaks.
    [*] Added a cooldown tooltip on the spell selection menu.
    [*] Most spells no longer collide with the level barrier.
[/list]
